Modello di lavoro: ibrido / a tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Insieme, facciamo colazione meglio

Come Global Total Rewards Manager presso CPW, guiderai l'agenda dei premi per una joint venture globale unica. Unirete competenze tecniche con una prospettiva esterna per progettare soluzioni che lavorano per CPW mentre bilanciate gli interessi di entrambe le società madri. Potrai operare indipendentemente, partner a stretto contatto con i leader senior, e portare chiarezza a decisioni complesse. Nella nostra squadra magra, tutti rotolano le maniche. Apprezziamo la curiosità, l'umiltà, le relazioni forti e il senso dell'umorismo. Questa è la possibilità di avere un impatto visibile sulla nostra gente, sul nostro business e sul nostro futuro.

Come farete un impatto come Global Total Rewards Manager

•
La formazione globale e locale premia le strategie che rafforzano la competitività e soddisfano le esigenze di business e di persone in evoluzione.

•
Guidare una cultura pay-for-performance attraverso strutture salariali competitive e incentivi significativi a breve e a lungo termine.

•
Costruire la comprensione e l'apprezzamento delle ricompense totali attraverso la comunicazione chiara, la costruzione delle capacità e l'efficace supporto della mobilità internazionale.

•
I principali cicli di ricompensa annuali con accuratezza, forte governance e esperienza senza soluzione di continuità per i dipendenti e gli stakeholder.

•
Rafforzare la valutazione del lavoro e la governance della ricompensa per garantire decisioni coerenti, eque e trasparenti in tutta l'organizzazione.

•
Garantire la disciplina e l'impegno attraverso i budget per il costo e l'incentivo delle persone in collaborazione con i team Finance e Human Resources nelle regioni e nei mercati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

•
Esperienza completa e approfondita nel portafoglio completo di premi.

•
Forte comprensione aziendale e finanziaria per collegare la strategia di ricompensa con le priorità delle persone e la creazione di valore sostenibile.

•
Ampia esperienza nell'analisi avanzata dei dati, metriche, budgeting e competenze del foglio di calcolo per trasformare intuizioni complesse in decisioni chiare.

•
Dimostrare una forte agilità di apprendimento, navigare rapidamente la complessità e adattare il vostro approccio, influenzando gli stakeholder senior tra funzioni, mercati e organizzazioni partner.

•
Comunicare fluentemente in inglese.

•
Dimostrando i valori della CPW di collaborazione, impegno, coraggio e capacità, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto ad aiutare a rendere la colazione migliore per milioni in tutto il mondo?

Applicare ora e aiutare le persone iniziare la giornata nel modo migliore possibile.

Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid / Vollzeit
Vertragsart/Dauer: Permanent

Gemeinsam machen wir das Frühstück besser

Als Global Total Rewards Manager bei CPW leiten Sie die Belohnungsagenda für ein einzigartiges globales Joint Venture. Sie kombinieren technisches Know-how mit einer externen Perspektive, um Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für CPW funktionieren und gleichzeitig die Interessen beider Muttergesellschaften in Einklang bringen. Sie arbeiten unabhängig, arbeiten eng mit leitenden Führungskräften zusammen und bringen Klarheit in komplexe Entscheidungen. In unserem Lean Team krempelt jeder die Ärmel hoch. Wir schätzen Neugier, Demut, starke Beziehungen und einen Sinn für Humor. Dies ist eine Chance, einen sichtbaren Einfluss auf unsere Mitarbeiter, unser Geschäft und unsere Zukunft zu haben.

Wie Sie als Global Total Rewards Manager Einfluss nehmen können

•
Die Gestaltung globaler und lokaler Gesamtbelohnungsstrategien stärkt die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und erfüllt die sich entwickelnden Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und Menschen.

•
Förderung einer Pay-for-Performance-Kultur durch wettbewerbsfähige Gehaltsstrukturen und sinnvolle kurz- und langfristige Anreize.

•
Aufbau von Verständnis und Wertschätzung der Gesamtbelohnung durch klare Kommunikation, Aufbau von Fähigkeiten und effektive internationale Mobilitätsunterstützung.

•
Führende jährliche Belohnungszyklen mit Genauigkeit, starker Governance und nahtloser Erfahrung für Mitarbeiter und Stakeholder.

•
Stärkung der Job-Evaluierung und der Belohnungs-Governance, um konsistente, faire und transparente Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen zu gewährleisten.

•
Gewährleistung von Disziplin und Engagement durch Personalkosten- und Incentive-Budgets in Zusammenarbeit mit Finanz- und Personalteams in allen Regionen und Märkten.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

•
Umfassende, eingehende Erfahrung über das gesamte Belohnungsportfolio.

•
Starkes Geschäfts- und Finanzverständnis, um die Belohnungsstrategie mit den Prioritäten der Menschen und der nachhaltigen Wertschöpfung zu verbinden.

•
Breite Erfahrung in fortgeschrittener Datenanalyse, Metriken, Budgetierung und Tabellenkalkulation, um komplexe Erkenntnisse in klare Entscheidungen zu verwandeln.

•
Demonstrieren Sie eine starke Lernflexibilität, navigieren Sie schnell durch Komplexität und passen Sie Ihren Ansatz an, während Sie leitende Stakeholder in Funktionen, Märkten und Partnerorganisationen beeinflussen.

•
fließend auf Englisch kommunizieren.

•
CPWs Werte der Zusammenarbeit, des Engagements, des Mutes und der Fähigkeit zu demonstrieren, während Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzt und gemeinsame Werte geschaffen werden.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, das Frühstück für Millionen auf der ganzen Welt besser zu machen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und helfen Sie den Menschen, ihren Tag bestmöglich zu beginnen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: La-Tour-De-Peilz, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Hybride / Temps plein
Type / durée du contrat: Permanent

Ensemble, nous faisons le petit déjeuner mieux

En tant que Global Total Rewards Manager chez CPW, vous dirigerez le programme de récompenses pour une coentreprise mondiale unique. Vous combinerez l'expertise technique avec une perspective externe pour concevoir des solutions qui fonctionnent pour CPW tout en conciliant les intérêts des deux sociétés mères. Vous agirez de façon indépendante, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants et vous clarifierez les décisions complexes. Dans notre équipe maigre, tout le monde remonte ses manches. Nous apprécions la curiosité, l'humilité, les relations fortes et le sens de l'humour. C'est une occasion de faire un impact visible sur nos gens, nos entreprises et notre avenir.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que Global Total Rewards Manager

•
L'élaboration de stratégies globales et locales de récompense qui renforcent la compétitivité et répondent aux besoins changeants des entreprises et des personnes.

•
Favoriser une culture de la rémunération au rendement au moyen de structures salariales concurrentielles et d'incitations significatives à court et à long terme.

•
Améliorer la compréhension et l'appréciation des avantages totaux grâce à une communication claire, au renforcement des capacités et à un soutien efficace à la mobilité internationale.

•
Diriger les cycles de récompense annuels avec précision, une gouvernance solide et une expérience transparente pour les employés et les intervenants.

•
Renforcer l'évaluation des emplois et récompenser la gouvernance afin d'assurer la cohérence, l'équité et la transparence des décisions dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

•
Assurer la discipline et l'engagement au moyen de budgets axés sur les coûts et les incitatifs, en partenariat avec les équipes des Finances et des Ressources humaines des régions et des marchés.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

•
Expérience complète et approfondie dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de récompenses.

•
Une solide compréhension des affaires et des finances pour relier la stratégie de récompense aux priorités humaines et à la création de valeur durable.

•
Grande expérience dans l'analyse de données avancée, les mesures, la budgétisation et les compétences de tableur pour transformer des idées complexes en décisions claires.

•
Démontrer une forte agilité d'apprentissage, naviguer rapidement dans la complexité et adapter votre approche tout en influençant les principaux intervenants dans les fonctions, les marchés et les organisations partenaires.

•
Communiquer couramment en anglais.

•
Démontrer les valeurs de collaboration, d'engagement, de courage et de capacité du CPW, tout en traduisant les idées en effets mesurables et en créant une valeur partagée.

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à aider à rendre le petit déjeuner meilleur pour des millions de personnes dans le monde?

Postulez maintenant et aidez les gens à commencer leur journée de la meilleure façon possible.

jobs.title: Human Resources Intern - Purina EUR
jobs.description:
Location: La Tour-de-Peilz, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Start date: February 2027

Deadline for applications: 05.11.2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

As a Human Resources Intern at Nestlé Purina Europe , your mission will be to support our Learning and Talent Development activities and help create engaging learning experiences for our people.

You will join a dynamic, international HR environment where you can take ownership, collaborate with different stakeholders and turn ideas into well-organised learning initiatives. This is an opportunity to make a real contribution while gaining hands-on HR experience, building your professional network and developing the skills needed to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a Human Resources Intern

• Support the coordination and delivery of training sessions, workshops and learning events

• Manage training invitations, participant communications and attendance tracking

• Coordinate practical arrangements, including meeting rooms, schedules and learning materials

• Maintain accurate training records and support reporting activities using Excel

• Contribute to Learning and Talent Development projects across Purina Europe

• Prepare clear and engaging presentations, communications and project materials

• Collaborate with HR colleagues and business stakeholders in an international environment

• Identify opportunities to improve the participant experience and simplify existing processes

What will make you successful

• Bachelor’s or Master’s student, or recent graduate, with a genuine interest in Human Resources, Learning and Development, Business Administration or a related field

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

• Confidence in coordinating several activities and following up with different stakeholders

• Clear and engaging communication skills

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint

• Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning

At Purina, we place people and pets at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

Insieme, facciamo colazione meglio.

Come leader globale SHE a CPW, la vostra missione è di guidare e rafforzare la nostra strategia di sicurezza, salute e ambiente attraverso le nostre fabbriche, centri di distribuzione e Head Office. Farete la differenza lavorando a stretto contatto con i team SHE locali, la leadership di fabbrica e gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. Questa è la vostra occasione per rendere la colazione migliore e aiutare le persone iniziare la giornata nel modo migliore possibile.

Come farete un impatto come un leader globale SHE

• Integrare la sicurezza come valore di leadership di base rafforzando la responsabilità e assicurando che SHE sia completamente integrato nel processo decisionale quotidiano e nelle routine operative.

• Guidare la trasformazione culturale SHE a livello di shopfloor elevando comportamenti di leadership front-line attraverso coaching mirati e comunicazione efficace.

• Sfrutta gli standard SHE globali in tutte le fabbriche CPW, assicurando la coerenza, consentendo al tempo stesso la proprietà locale e le culture di sicurezza ad alto rendimento.

• Rafforzare la gestione e la resilienza dei rischi guidando solidi quadri di audit e piani di prevenzione proattivi per ridurre i rischi operativi.

• Costruisci capacità sostenibili sviluppando leader di fabbrica e professionisti SHE, rafforzando competenze, mentalità e conformità a lungo termine.

• Accelera il miglioramento continuo identificando, condividendo e scalando le migliori pratiche e soluzioni innovative in tutti i siti.

• Influenza le prestazioni aziendali collaborando trasversalmente per elevare i risultati SHE e sostenere operazioni sicure e sostenibili.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare un'esperienza comprovata in Sicurezza all'interno di ambienti industriali complessi, con un forte record di traccia nella guida della trasformazione della cultura della sicurezza. L'esperienza operativa e l'influenza tra le organizzazioni regionali o globali è un vantaggio, mentre l'esperienza di leadership pratica a livello di negozio rimane un forte vantaggio.

• Forte competenza nei sistemi di gestione SHE, controllo e gestione dei rischi, completata da certificazioni di sicurezza riconosciute (ad esempio, NEBOSH, ISO Lead Auditor o equivalente).

• Altamente efficace influenzatore degli stakeholder, in grado di coinvolgere, sfidare e allineare i leader attraverso funzioni, geografie e livelli dell'organizzazione.

• comunicatore chiaro e d'impatto, fluente in inglese (francese è un plus), capace di connettersi con il pubblico da team di shopfloor a leadership senior.

• Modello di ruolo dei valori CPW, dimostrando collaborazione, impegno, coraggio e capacità nella guida dei risultati aziendali e delle persone.

A CPW, collaborazione e scopo guidare tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Arbeitsmodell : Full-Time Act. Rate 100%

Vertragsart/Dauer: Unbefristeter Vertrag

Gemeinsam machen wir das Frühstück besser.

Als Global SHE Lead bei CPW ist es Ihre Mission, unsere Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltstrategie in unseren Fabriken, Vertriebszentren und Hauptsitzen zu führen und zu stärken. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit lokalen SHE-Teams, der Fabrikleitung und internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, das Frühstück besser zu machen und den Menschen zu helfen, ihren Tag bestmöglich zu beginnen.

Wie Sie als Global SHE Lead Einfluss nehmen werden

• Betten Sie Sicherheit als einen zentralen Führungswert ein, indem Sie die Rechenschaftspflicht stärken und sicherstellen, dass SHE vollständig in die täglichen Entscheidungs- und Betriebsroutinen integriert ist.

• Fördern Sie die kulturelle Transformation von SHE auf Shopfloor-Ebene, indem Sie das Führungsverhalten an vorderster Front durch gezieltes Coaching und wirkungsvolle Kommunikation verbessern.

• Einsatz globaler SHE-Standards in allen CPW-Fabriken, um Konsistenz zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig lokales Eigentum und leistungsstarke Sicherheitskulturen zu ermöglichen.

• Stärkung des Risikomanagements und der Widerstandsfähigkeit durch robuste Auditrahmen und proaktive Präventionspläne zur Verringerung operativer Risiken.

• Aufbau nachhaltiger Fähigkeiten durch die Entwicklung von Fabrikführern und SHE-Experten, die Stärkung von Fachwissen, Denkweise und langfristiger Compliance.

• Beschleunigen Sie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung, indem Sie Best Practices und innovative Lösungen standortübergreifend identifizieren, teilen und skalieren.

• Beeinflussen Sie die Geschäftsleistung durch funktionsübergreifende Partnerschaften, um die SHE-Ergebnisse zu verbessern und einen sicheren, nachhaltigen Betrieb zu unterstützen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Erprobte Erfahrung im Bereich Sicherheit in komplexen industriellen Umgebungen mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz bei der Transformation der Sicherheitskultur. Erfahrung im Betrieb und in der Beeinflussung regionaler oder globaler Organisationen ist ein Plus, während praktische Führungserfahrung auf Shopfloor-Ebene nach wie vor ein großer Vorteil ist.

• Starke Expertise in SHE Managementsystemen, Auditing und Risikomanagement, ergänzt durch anerkannte Sicherheitszertifizierungen (z. B. NEBOSH, ISO Lead Auditor oder gleichwertig).

• Hocheffektiver Stakeholder-Influencer, der in der Lage ist, Führungskräfte über Funktionen, Regionen und Ebenen des Unternehmens hinweg zu engagieren, herauszufordern und auszurichten.

• Klarer und wirkungsvoller Kommunikator, fließend Englisch (Französisch ist ein Plus), der in der Lage ist, sich mit dem Publikum von Shopfloor-Teams bis hin zu Führungskräften zu verbinden.

• Rollenmodell der CPW-Werte, das Zusammenarbeit, Engagement, Mut und Fähigkeit zur Förderung von Geschäfts- und Menschenergebnissen demonstriert.

Bei CPW steuern Zusammenarbeit und Zweck alles, was wir tun.

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bereit, das Frühstück für Millionen auf der ganzen Welt besser zu machen?
Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und helfen Sie den Menschen, ihren Tag bestmöglich zu beginnen.

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und wachsen Sie durch Erfahrungen, die Sie weiter vorantreiben.

jobs.description:
Location: La Tour-de-Peilz, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Brand Experience Specialist at Nestlé Suisse S.A., your mission is to rejuvenate THOMY and deepen consumer loyalty by delivering integrated brand experiences that strengthen emotional connection and drive sustainable growth. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, sales, communications, food-service teams, agencies and sponsorship partners. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Brand Experience Specialist

• Turning consumer, cultural and category insights into compelling brand experiences that grow brand relevance and commercial impact.

• Shaping an omnichannel activation strategy that creates a seamless THOMY experience across the OOH / convenience channel.

• Activating an external network to build high-value local sponsorship partnerships that expand visibility, strengthen brand meaning and unlock sustainable growth.

• Developing and executing brand activations, live marketing events and brand experiences that convert participation into lasting loyalty, engagement and advocacy.

• Delivering integrated amplification plans that connect every activation to brand priorities and measurable business outcomes.

• Driving excellent execution through clear collaboration, smart resource allocation and continuous learning from results.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in brand marketing, consumer activation, communications, or shopper marketing, while acting as a passionate ambassador for THOMY both internally and externally.

• Applying Out-of-Home market knowledge to deliver integrated omnichannel activations that strengthen brand visibility and drive business results across the region, supported by the flexibility to travel regularly and a valid driver's license.

• Using consumer insights, performance metrics, and budget management expertise to optimize execution, measure effectiveness, and maximize return on investment.

• Collaborating effectively with agencies, external partners, and cross-functional teams while leading projects from brief to successful implementation.

• Communicating fluently in Swiss German/German and English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed, and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre

In qualità di Brand Experience Specialist presso Nestlé Suisse S.A., la vostra missione è di ringiovanire THOMY e approfondire la lealtà dei consumatori, offrendo esperienze di brand integrate che rafforzano la connessione emotiva e spingono la crescita sostenibile. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con marketing, vendite, comunicazioni, team di food-service, agenzie e partner di sponsorizzazione. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fare la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come specialista di Brand Experience

• Trasformando intuizioni di consumatori, culturali e di categoria in convincenti esperienze di marca che crescono la rilevanza del marchio e l'impatto commerciale.

• Definire una strategia di attivazione omnicanale che crea un'esperienza di THOMY senza soluzione di continuità attraverso il canale OOH / convenienza.

• Attivare una rete esterna per costruire partnership di sponsorizzazione locale di alto valore che espandono la visibilità, rafforzino il significato del marchio e sbloccano la crescita sostenibile.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire le attivazioni del marchio, eventi di marketing dal vivo e le esperienze del marchio che convertono la partecipazione in una duratura fedeltà, impegno e advocacy.

• Fornire piani di amplificazione integrati che collegano ogni attivazione alle priorità del marchio e risultati aziendali misurabili.

• Guidare l'esecuzione eccellente attraverso una collaborazione chiara, allocazione intelligente delle risorse e apprendimento continuo dai risultati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portando una forte esperienza nel marketing del marchio, nell'attivazione dei consumatori, nelle comunicazioni o nel marketing degli shopper, agendo come ambasciatore appassionato di THOMY sia internamente che esternamente.

• Applicando conoscenze di mercato Out-of-Home per fornire attivazioni omnichannel integrate che rafforzano la visibilità del marchio e i risultati aziendali di guida in tutta la regione, supportato dalla flessibilità di viaggiare regolarmente e dalla valida licenza del conducente.

• Usando intuizioni dei consumatori, metriche di performance e competenze di gestione del bilancio per ottimizzare l'esecuzione, misurare l'efficacia e massimizzare il ritorno sugli investimenti.

• Collaborare efficacemente con le agenzie, i partner esterni e i team interfunzionali, mentre i progetti principali dalla breve alla riuscita dell'implementazione.

• Comunicare fluentemente in tedesco / tedesco svizzero e inglese.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Ci impegniamo a un processo di assunzione interno equo e trasparente e assicuriamo che tutte le applicazioni siano trattate con riservatezza.

La tua applicazione in genere includerà una recensione iniziale, conversazioni con Talent Acquisition e il team di assunzione, seguita da una discussione finale.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a crescere con noi?

Applicare ora e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre.

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Chez Nestlé Professional , nous accompagnons les professionnels de la restauration avec des solutions café et culinaires de premier plan, permettant aux amateurs de gastronomie à travers toute la Suisse de profiter de produits de haute qualité grâce à des marques emblématiques telles que STARBUCKS®, NESCAFÉ®, THOMY®, MAGGI®, CAILLER® et CHEF® .

En tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages , vous rejoignez une équipe expérimentée et engagée. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de comptes stratégiques sur l'Est de la Suisse romande, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités commerciales, en élaborant des stratégies de croissance et en créant des partenariats durables avec vos clients.

Véritable partenaire de confiance, vous serez l'interlocuteur privilégié de vos clients et contribuerez activement au développement de votre portefeuille en conciliant acquisition de nouveaux comptes, fidélisation des clients existants et atteinte durable des objectifs commerciaux.

Votre impact en tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages

• Développer et entretenir des relations partenariales solides avec les clients, en agissant comme interlocuteur privilégié et en garantissant leur satisfaction à long terme.

So werden Sie als Coffee Specialist einen Unterschied machen

• Sicherstellen eines herzlichen Empfangs und eines angenehmen Erlebnisses für unsere Gäste sowie individuelle Beratung unserer Kundschaft, Durchführung von Kaffeedegustationen und aktiver Verkauf unserer Produkte

• Aktiver Beitrag zur Erreichung individueller sowie Boutique-Ziele und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Kundenerlebnisses in der Boutique

Was Sie erfolgreich macht

• Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung im Retail oder in der Gastronomie

• Ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung sowie Leidenschaft für Kaffee, Marke und einzigartige Kundenerlebnisse

• Interesse und Freude daran, technische Fragestellungen rund um Kaffeemaschinen zu lösen sowie Ihr Wissen mit Kolleg:innen zu teilen

• Erfahrung in der Schulung, Unterstützung oder fachlichen Begleitung von Kolleg:innen ist von Vorteil

• Flexible, gut organisierte und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist

Was Sie bei Nespresso erwartet

Wir wachsen gemeinsam – in einer Kultur der Wertschätzung, Inklusion und Innovation. Unsere Benefits unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung und Ihr Wohlbefinden:

• Zusätzliche Ferientage über den gesetzlichen Anspruch hinaus

• Beitrag zur Gesundheitsversorgung und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program für Sie und Ihre Familie

• Attraktiver Arbeitgeberbeitrag zur Pensionskasse

In welcher Funktion auch immer – Sie können echte Veränderungen bewirken und andere für Ihre Ideen begeistern. Bei Nespresso werden Sie aufblühen und sich zugehörig fühlen. Wir inspirieren Sie, sich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und Ihr Bestes zu geben.

descriptionByLocale.en:

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

Being a Coffee Specialist at Nespresso You are our customer: women with your passion for service and coffee. As the first contact person in the boutique, you will recognize their needs and create a first-class brand experience through personal advice. This is your chance to help shape the world of coffee and create real added value.

This is how you as a coffee specialist will make a difference

• Ensuring a warm welcome and a pleasant experience for our guests as well as individual advice to our customers, conducting coffee tastings and actively selling our products

• Independent repair of simple machine faults and coordination of repairs

• Support and advice of the team in technical issues related to our coffee machines

• Support in the management of spare parts and the handling of technical customer concerns in cooperation with our service partners

• Recording of orders, carrying out cash invoice as well as careful maintenance and ongoing updating of the customer file

• Active contribution to the achievement of individual and boutique goals and to the continuous improvement of the customer experience in the boutique

What makes you successful

• Training or professional experience in retail or gastronomy

• Strong service and customer orientation as well as passion for coffee, brand and unique customer experiences

• Interest and pleasure in solving technical questions about coffee machines as well as sharing your knowledge with colleagues:

• Experience in training, support or professional support of colleagues: inside is an advantage

• Flexible, well organized and reliable personality with a strong team spirit

• Negotiable knowledge of German, other languages such as English are a plus

• We Inspire, We Care, We Act, and We Innovate

What to expect at Nespresso

We grow together – in a culture of appreciation, inclusion and innovation. Our benefits support your development and well-being:

• Attractive employee discounts on a variety of products and services of daily needs

• Performance based bonus

• Additional holiday days beyond the legal entitlement

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive support services for families

• Contributing to health care and access to the Employee Assistance Program for you and your family

• Attractive employer contribution to the pension fund

• Leistungsorientierter Bonus

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und gestalten Sie neu, was Sie werden können.

• Un service fort et une orientation client ainsi que la passion pour le café, la marque et des expériences client uniques

jobs.title: Packaging Development Intern
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months, full-time
Start date: January/February 2027

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As a Packaging Development Intern at Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee (NPTC Coffee), your mission is to support the development and industrialization of innovative packaging solutions for the Nescafé Dolce Gusto business. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with packaging experts, project managers, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. This is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience in packaging development while contributing to projects that improve sustainability, performance, and cost efficiency.

How you’ll make an impact as a Packaging Development Intern

• Support the industrialization and evaluation of new packaging materials for strategic Nescafé Dolce Gusto projects.

• Participate in laboratory activities, pilot line trials, and packaging testing to validate technical solutions.

• Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners to assess packaging performance and support implementation activities.

• Lead or contribute to technical discussions with suppliers and prepare test reports and project presentations.

• Help drive packaging innovation by supporting projects focused on material optimization, sustainability, and cost reduction.

What will make you successful

• Recent graduate or currently completing a Master's degree in Packaging, Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, or a related field

• Knowledge of polymer materials and sealing technologies, with a genuine interest in packaging development and industrialization

• Strong analytical skills combined with attention to detail and systems thinking. Knowledge of SPSS software is a plus

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional and international stakeholders

• Proactive, agile and independent mindset with a willingness to learn and collaborate on projects

• Fluent English (written & spoken)

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Start date: December 1, 2026

Deadline for applications: September 15, 2026

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Corporate Paralegal in the Corporate & Finance Counsel Team at Nestlé, your mission is to support corporate legal housekeeping, governance and compliance for the Group’s Swiss-based legal entities. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with other Legal & Compliance teams, Group Finance & Control, Human Resources, markets worldwide, external advisors and service providers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Corporate Paralegal

• Preparing and executing corporate documents for board and shareholder meetings, including agendas, proxies and minutes and supporting applications to the Commercial Register.

• Contributing to the preparation of Nestlé’s Annual General Meeting.

• Coordinating legalization, notarization, apostille, and ownership certification processes with accuracy.

• Maintaining reliable share registers, legal entity data and digital records for reporting, due diligence and compliance.

• Supporting corporate transactions, including incorporations, liquidations and restructurings by preparing documents, monitoring projects and coordinating follow-ups.

• Contributing to Nestlé’s compliance with ongoing listing obligations stemming from the stock exchange regulation.

• Driving continuous improvement, digitalization and standardization of legal processes, templates and knowledge management practices.

What will make you successful

• Bringing legal training or proven experience gained in Switzerland, with strong knowledge of the Swiss legal and corporate environment.

• Collaborating openly and transparently with colleagues within the team, internal business partners and external stakeholders.

• Applying strong project management skills to manage deadlines, coordinate stakeholders and follow through on complex matters.

• Using attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership to ensure data quality, accurate records and confidential handling of information.

• Challenging existing processes with a pragmatic mindset and using digital tools to improve ways of working.

• Communicating fluently in French and English; German is a strong asset.

• Demonstrating courage, speed and continuous learning.

Che cosa vi farà successo

Shape & pioneer the next generation of Nespresso coffee experiences.

As Global Head of Coffee at Nespresso, you will help define the future of premium coffee . Bringing deep, end-to-end Coffee R&D expertise from origin and agronomy at the farm through green coffee transformation to the final consumer experience, you will serve as Nespresso's highest coffee authority. You will champion Nespresso Coffee Excellence and ensure the integrity of the consumer coffee experience is sustained over time. Combining your own expertise with the breadth of the Nestlé coffee R&D network, you will unite science, consumer insight and business ambition behind a bold vision. Leading a multidisciplinary Coffee and Sensory Organisation, you will turn pioneering advances into distinctive experiences across our B2C and B2B platforms and embed coffee excellence throughout Nespresso, bringing it to life for colleagues and consumers, in our boutiques and beyond.

How you'll make an impact as Global Head of Coffee

• Set the global Coffee R&D vision and strategy, translating it into technology roadmaps, investment priorities and portfolio choices that shape our long-term competitive advantage

• Mobilise the full Nestlé coffee R&D network, from plant science and agronomy to transformation, roasting and sensory, behind Nespresso's coffee ambition

• Shape the coffee innovation portfolio across Nespresso's evolving B2C and B2B coffee platforms, making decisive choices on value, risk, quality, investment and speed

• Be the voice of the consumer coffee experience in critical end-to-end decisions, defining the principles of coffee and sensory excellence and ensuring cost, operational and sustainability choices strengthen Nespresso’s quality & distinctiveness.

• Forge strategic partnerships that accelerate scientific breakthroughs and deliver measurable impact across the organisation

• Build & lead a world class multidisciplinary Coffee and Sensory organisation, building the talent, capabilities and accountability needed to deliver at scale

• Embed coffee excellence throughout Nespresso and serve as its highest coffee authority externally, bringing our expertise to life with internal colleagues, in our boutiques and across industry, academia, media and thought leadership.

What will make you successful

• Demonstrated end-to-end expertise in coffee research and development, covering origin, agronomy, green coffee, transformation, roasting, extraction, sensory science, and product experience, complemented by multiple leadership roles in the coffee and FMCG sectors.

• Visionary & strategic thinking, with the ability to connect emerging science, consumer needs and business opportunities into a compelling long-term direction

• A strong record of turning science and technology into distinctive, premium experiences and scalable commercial outcomes

• Leadership of world-class specialists through purpose, trust and clarity, creating high performance without micromanagement

• Enterprise influence and strategic judgement, with excellent communication, fluency in English, influencing senior stakeholders with purpose, trust, clarity and sound judgement

• Commercial courage to prioritize investment, challenge established thinking, manage trade-offs and stop work that will not create sufficient value

• Be the voice of the consumer coffee experience in critical end-to-end decisions, defining the principles of coffee and sensory excellence and ensuring cost, operational and sustainability choices strengthen Nespresso’s quality & distinctiveness.

• Forge strategic partnerships that accelerate scientific breakthroughs and deliver measurable impact across the organisation

• Build & lead a world class multidisciplinary Coffee and Sensory organisation, building the talent, capabilities and accountability needed to deliver at scale

• Embed coffee excellence throughout Nespresso and serve as its highest coffee authority externally, bringing our expertise to life with internal colleagues, in our boutiques and across industry, academia, media and thought leadership.

What will make you successful

• Demonstrated end-to-end expertise in coffee research and development, covering origin, agronomy, green coffee, transformation, roasting, extraction, sensory science, and product experience, complemented by multiple leadership roles in the coffee and FMCG sectors.

• Visionary & strategic thinking, with the ability to connect emerging science, consumer needs and business opportunities into a compelling long-term direction

• A strong record of turning science and technology into distinctive, premium experiences and scalable commercial outcomes

• Leadership of world-class specialists through purpose, trust and clarity, creating high performance without micromanagement

• Enterprise influence and strategic judgement, with excellent communication, fluency in English, influencing senior stakeholders with purpose, trust, clarity and sound judgement

• Commercial courage to prioritize investment, challenge established thinking, manage trade-offs and stop work that will not create sufficient value

• Bringing our WE CAN mindset to life through collaboration, courage, speed and continuous learning, while driving performance with respect and care at the foundation.

What to expect from our hiring process

• Mobilisierung des gesamten Forschungs- und Entwicklungsnetzwerks für Nestlé-Kaffee, von Pflanzenwissenschaft und Agronomie bis hin zu Transformation, Röstung und Sensorik, hinter Nespressos Kaffeeambitionen

Was dich erfolgreich macht

Forme et pionnier de la prochaine génération d'expériences de café Nespresso.

En tant que Global Head of Coffee à Nespresso, vous aiderez à définir l'avenir du café premium. Apportant une expertise en R-D de bout en bout de café de l'origine et de l'agronomie à la ferme grâce à la transformation du café vert à l'expérience finale du consommateur, vous serez la plus haute autorité de café de Nespresso. Vous serez champion Nespresso Coffee Excellence et assurer l'intégrité de l'expérience de café de consommation est soutenue au fil du temps. Combinant votre propre expertise avec l'étendue du réseau de R-D pour le café de Nestlé, vous unirez la science, la perspicacité des consommateurs et l'ambition des entreprises à une vision audacieuse. Dirigez une organisation multidisciplinaire du café et de la sensorialité, vous transformerez les avancées pionnières en expériences distinctives sur nos plateformes B2C et B2B et intégrerz l'excellence du café dans l'ensemble de Nespresso, ce qui le fera vivre pour nos collègues et consommateurs, dans nos boutiques et au-delà.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que Responsable Global du Café

• Définir la vision et la stratégie mondiales de la R-D du café, la traduire en feuilles de route technologiques, en priorités d'investissement et en choix de portefeuille qui façonnent notre avantage concurrentiel à long terme

• Mobiliser le réseau complet de R & D du café Nestlé, de la science des plantes et de l'agronomie à la transformation, la torréfaction et la sensorielle, derrière l'ambition café Nespresso

• Former le portefeuille d'innovations café sur les plateformes de café B2C et B2B en évolution de Nespresso, faire des choix décisifs sur la valeur, le risque, la qualité, l'investissement et la vitesse

• Expertise démontrée de bout en bout dans la recherche et le développement du café, couvrant l'origine, l'agronomie, le café vert, la transformation, la torréfaction, l'extraction, la science sensorielle et l'expérience des produits, complétée par de multiples rôles de leadership dans les secteurs du café et du FMCG.

• Leadership de spécialistes de calibre mondial grâce à la finalité, la confiance et la clarté, créant des performances élevées sans microgestion

• Le courage commercial de privilégier l'investissement, de remettre en question la pensée établie, de gérer les compromis et d'arrêter le travail qui ne créera pas une valeur suffisante

• Ranimer notre mentalité grâce à la collaboration, au courage, à la vitesse et à l'apprentissage continu, tout en conduisant la performance avec respect et soin à la fondation.

Company: Nestlé Schweiz S.A.

Start of employment: immediately or by agreement

Short overview position

550 employees, who are responsible for the production of high-quality infant food for Germany and abroad, shape the dynamic, highly automated working environment of the Konolfingen factory. This places high demands on our team every day in terms of compliance with hygiene regulations and occupational safety. Would you also like to be part of our team?

To strengthen our Special Products (SP) department, we are looking for a communicative and responsible personality as a plant manager.

A day in the life of a plant manager

• Processing of milk and children’s foods with the help of modern production facilities

• Implementation of the feed of raw materials, spray drying and mixing, provision and filling of powder

• Implementation of the cleaning process (CIP cleaning) as well as general cleaning work according to the existing quality specifications

• Documentation of production and cleaning processes

• Activities in the line laboratory and carrying out analyses according to QMS

• Responsibility for product manufacturing in compliance with safety, hygiene and environmental regulations as well as NGMP and SOP's

• Ensuring careful handling of raw and packaging materials as well as energies, plants, laboratory equipment and cleaning agents

• Readiness for shift and weekend work

This makes them successful.

• Successfully completed EFZ training as a dairy technologist or food technologist or many years of experience as a plant manager in the food sector

• Good technical understanding and proactive action

• Customer-oriented behavior in all work situations

• Strong safety, environmental and hygiene awareness

• Team-capable and independent personality who shows initiative and commitment

• Practical handling in SAP, MES and MS Office

• Very good oral and written knowledge of German

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives, and work at a scale and pace that made a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive and collaborative environment that inspires positive change, welcomes innovation and empowers people and teams to win.

Do you want to do great things for the very little ones in this world? Become part of Nestlé and send us your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas, etc.) directly online.

Short overview position

550 employees, who are responsible for the production of high-quality infant food for Germany and abroad, shape the dynamic, highly automated working environment of the Konolfingen factory. This places high demands on our team every day in terms of compliance with hygiene regulations and occupational safety. Would you also like to be part of our team?

To strengthen our Fill & Pack department, we are looking for a communicative and responsible personality as a plant manager.

• Product and can manufacturing in compliance with safety, hygiene and environmental regulations as well as NGMP and SOPs

• Execution of line laboratory analyses and replenishment of production, fault reports and checklists

• Ensuring careful handling of raw and packaging materials as well as energies, plants, laboratory equipment and cleaning agents

• Understanding the TPM process and aligning line activities with its objectives

• Daily work with DMO (Digital Manufacturing Objects) and SAP (Time and Material Accounting)

• Support for technical problems

• Readiness for shift and weekend work (4-shift operation)

This makes them successful.

• Successfully completed training in the field of packaging or as a food technologist (EFZ) or comparable training with corresponding qualifications

• Several years of professional experience in the same or similar capacity

• Strong technical flair and interest in technical renewals

• Team-capable, flexible, initiative and open-minded personality

• Good communication characteristics and assertiveness

• Very good knowledge of German

• Good IT skills

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives, and work at a scale and pace that made a difference. Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

En tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Digital Transformation & AI Agents , vous participerez à la transformation digitale de l'usine en développant des agents d'intelligence artificielle capables d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle et l'expérience des collaborateurs.

Comment aurez-vous un impact en tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Digital Transformation & AI Agents ?

• Identifier des opportunités d'amélioration en collaborant avec les équipes métiers afin de repérer les processus pouvant être optimisés grâce à l'intelligence artificielle.

• Développer et déployer des agents IA à l'aide des solutions Microsoft Copilot et SharePoint Agents pour répondre aux besoins des différents départements.

• Accompagner l'adoption de l'IA en formant et en soutenant un réseau de référents, tout en promouvant les bonnes pratiques d'utilisation.

• Mesurer l'impact des solutions mises en œuvre et contribuer à la feuille de route future de la transformation digitale de l'usine.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Etudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'Ingénieur-e ou Master universitaire dans des spécialisations telles que : Data & AI, Systèmes d'information, Transformation digitale ou Business Analytics

• Esprit analytique et capacité à comprendre rapidement les enjeux métiers.

• Aisance relationnelle et aptitude à transformer des besoins opérationnels en solutions digitales.

• Autonomie, curiosité et goût pour l'innovation.

• Connaissance de Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Power BI, SharePoint, SQL, Python ou des outils d'IA générative constitue un atout.

Avantages

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Possibilité de formation et de développement internes

• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur

• Participation financière à l’assurance maladie

• Politique parentalité avantageuse

• Parking gratuit et bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques

• Nombreux avantages auprès du Club Nespresso

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

Als Projektingenieur Bau & Projektkoordination bei der Nestlé Suisse besteht Ihre Mission darin, die Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bauprojekten unterschiedlicher Komplexität für unsere THOMY Fabrik in Basel sicherzustellen. Das Aufgabenspektrum reicht von kleineren Unterhalts- und Sanierungsmassnahmen bis hin zu Neu- und Umbauprojekten. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit internen Kunden, Behörden, Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihre Expertise weiterzuentwickeln und die Zukunft unseres Produktionsstandorts aktiv mitzugestalten.

So werden Sie als Projektingenieur Bau & Projektkoordination einen Unterschied machen

• Selbstständige Leitung und Begleitung von Bauprojekten von der Bedürfnisdefinition bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

• Planung, Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Überwachung von Bau- und Unterhaltsmassnahmen sowie Erstellung von Projekt-, Kosten- und Terminplänen und Sicherstellung deren Einhaltung.

• Führung und Koordination von externen Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern.

• Durchführung von Zustandsanalysen und Erarbeitung von Sanierungs- und Instandhaltungskonzepten sowie Organisation und Begleitung von Umbauten, Renovationen und kleineren Neubauprojekten.

• Überwachung der Bauausführung, Durchführung von Baustellenbegehungen sowie Kontrolle von Offerten, Rechnungen und Nachträgen.

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher sowie Nestlé-interner Vorschriften zur Arbeitssicherheit, interner Vorgaben, Qualitätsstandards und Compliance-Richtlinien für den Bereich Bau sowie Ansprechperson für interne Kunden, Behörden, Planer und Unternehmer.

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

• Hintergrund als Bauingenieur, Architekt, Techniker Bauplanung/Bauführung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Erfahrung in der Projektleitung und Bauausführung.

• Erfahrung in der Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bau- und Umbauprojekten.

• Kenntnisse in Bauleitung, Ausschreibungen und Vergabeverfahren sowie ein gutes Verständnis für bautechnische, wirtschaftliche und organisatorische Zusammenhänge.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Behörden, Planern und Unternehmern sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise in enger Abstimmung mit den anderen Abteilungen der Fabrik.

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Organisations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeiten sowie sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Kenntnisse von CAD- oder Projektmanagement-Tools sind von Vorteil.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Mut, Teamorientierung, Agilität und kontinuierliche Lernbereitschaft.

Bei Nestlé stehen Menschen im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns

• Beitrag an Gesundheitsleistungen sowie Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program für Sie und Ihre Familie

• Attraktive Arbeitgeberbeiträge an die Pensionskasse

• Leistungsorientierter Bonus

• Grosszügige Elternzeit und umfassende Familienunterstützung

• Vielfältige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer Fähigkeiten

• Mitarbeiterrabatte auf verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Rekrutierungsprozess erwarten können

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Rekrutierungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Unterstützungsmassnahmen zur Verfügung. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt. Moderne Einrichtungen und Prozesse sorgen für ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld für alle.

Daher empfehlen wir eine frühzeitige Bewerbung. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Vorsicht vor Betrugsversuchen: Nestlé kontaktiert Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten ausschliesslich über offizielle E-Mail-Adressen des Unternehmens und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt im Rekrutierungsprozess Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und beschleunigen Sie Veränderungen, die das Leben von Menschen und unseren Planeten verbessern.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Modello di lavoro: A tempo pieno, in loco, su piccola scala, ufficio domestico può essere possibile

Tipo di contratto / durata: Unfriended

Data di inizio: immediata o di accordo

Essere una forza per il cambiamento buono e accelera che migliora la vita e il pianeta

In qualità di Project Engineer Construction & Project Coordination presso Nestlé Suisse, la vostra missione è quella di garantire la progettazione, il coordinamento e la realizzazione di progetti di costruzione di varia complessità per la nostra fabbrica di THOMY a Basilea. La gamma di compiti spazia da misure di manutenzione e ristrutturazione più piccole a nuovi e progetti di conversione. Si farà la differenza lavorando a stretto contatto con clienti interni, autorità, pianificatori, architetti, ingegneri e imprenditori. Questa è la vostra opportunità di assumersi la responsabilità, sviluppare le vostre competenze e modellare attivamente il futuro del nostro sito di produzione.

Come ingegnere del progetto, farete la differenza nella costruzione e coordinamento del progetto.

• Gestione indipendente e supporto di progetti di costruzione dalla definizione di necessità alla messa in servizio.

• Pianificazione, appalto, assegnazione e monitoraggio delle misure di costruzione e manutenzione, nonché la stesura di progetti, costi e programmi e la loro conformità.

• Leadership e coordinamento di progettisti esterni, architetti, ingegneri e imprenditori.

• Attuazione di analisi delle condizioni e sviluppo di concetti di ristrutturazione e manutenzione, nonché organizzazione e supporto di conversioni, ristrutturazioni e piccoli nuovi progetti di costruzione.

• Supervisione di costruzione, visite di cantiere e controllo di offerte, fatture e integratori.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle normative legali e Nestlé-internal in materia di sicurezza sul lavoro, requisiti interni, standard di qualità e linee guida di conformità per il settore delle costruzioni, nonché persona di contatto per clienti interni, autorità, pianificatori e imprenditori.

Questo li rende di successo.

• Sfondo come ingegnere civile, architetto, tecnico di pianificazione delle costruzioni / gestione della costruzione o qualifica paragonabile con esperienza nella gestione del progetto e costruzione.

• Esperienza nella pianificazione, coordinamento e realizzazione di progetti di costruzione e conversione.

• Conoscenza delle procedure di gestione delle costruzioni, di appalto e di appalto nonché una buona comprensione delle connessioni strutturali, economiche e organizzative.

• Esperienza nel trattare con autorità, pianificatori e imprenditori, nonché un metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione in stretto coordinamento con gli altri dipartimenti della fabbrica.

• Forte comunicazione, capacità organizzative e di esecuzione e uso sicuro di MS Office; La conoscenza di CAD o strumenti di gestione di progetto è un vantaggio.

• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco nella parola e nella scrittura; La conoscenza dell'inglese è un vantaggio.

• Coraggio, orientamento di squadra, agilità e disponibilità continua ad imparare.

A Nestlé, le persone sono al centro delle nostre azioni

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per promuovere la vostra crescita e il benessere in modo da poter avere successo sia professionalmente che privatamente:

• Giorni festivi aggiuntivi oltre i requisiti legali

• Contribuisci servizi sanitari e l'accesso al Programma di Assistenza per i Dipendenti per te e la tua famiglia

• Contributo del datore di lavoro attraente al fondo pensione

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Generoso congedo parentale e supporto familiare completo

• Diverse opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per sviluppare ulteriormente le tue competenze

• Sconti dei dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa ci si può aspettare dal nostro processo di reclutamento

Siamo impegnati in un processo di reclutamento inclusivo e rispettoso e siamo lieti di fornire adeguate misure di sostegno, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza. Strutture e processi moderni garantiscono un ambiente di lavoro sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di reclutamento di solito include un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e un'intervista finale e un'offerta. Rivediamo continuamente le domande e chiudiamo la chiamata non appena abbiamo identificato una forte selezione di candidati rilevanti. Pertanto, si consiglia una prima applicazione. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate come riservate.

Attenzione ai tentativi di frode: Nestlé contatta i candidati esclusivamente attraverso gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non richiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili durante il processo di reclutamento.

Pronti ad essere una forza per il bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare i cambiamenti che migliorano la vita delle persone e del nostro pianeta.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Work model: Full-time, on-site, on a small scale, home office may be possible

Contract type / duration: Unfriended

Start date: By immediate or by agreement

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Project Engineer Construction & Project Coordination at Nestlé Suisse, your mission is to ensure the planning, coordination and realization of construction projects of varying complexity for our THOMY factory in Basel. The range of tasks ranges from smaller maintenance and renovation measures to new and conversion projects. You will make a difference by working closely with internal clients, authorities, planners, architects, engineers and entrepreneurs. This is your opportunity to take on responsibility, develop your expertise and actively shape the future of our production site.

As a project engineer, you will make a difference in construction and project coordination.

• Independent management and support of construction projects from need definition to commissioning.

• Planning, tendering, awarding and monitoring of construction and maintenance measures as well as drawing up project, cost and schedules and ensuring compliance with them.

• Leadership and coordination of external planners, architects, engineers and entrepreneurs.

• Implementation of condition analyses and development of renovation and maintenance concepts as well as organization and support of conversions, renovations and smaller new construction projects.

• Supervision of construction, construction site visits and control of offers, invoices and supplements.

• Ensure compliance with legal and Nestlé-internal regulations on occupational safety, internal requirements, quality standards and compliance guidelines for the construction sector as well as contact person for internal customers, authorities, planners and entrepreneurs.

This makes them successful.

• Background as a civil engineer, architect, technician of construction planning/construction management or comparable qualification with experience in project management and construction.

• Experience in planning, coordinating and realizing construction and conversion projects.

• Knowledge of construction management, tendering and procurement procedures as well as a good understanding of structural, economic and organisational connections.

• Experience in dealing with authorities, planners and entrepreneurs as well as an independent, structured and solution-oriented working method in close coordination with the other departments of the factory.

• Strong communication, organizational and enforcement capabilities and secure use of MS Office; Knowledge of CAD or project management tools is an advantage.

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing; Knowledge of English is an advantage.

• Courage, team orientation, agility and continuous willingness to learn.

At Nestlé, people are at the heart of our actions

Our benefits are designed to promote your growth and well-being so that you can succeed both professionally and privately:

• Additional holiday days beyond the legal requirements

• Contribute health services and access to the Employee Assistance Program for you and your family

• Attractive employer contributions to the pension fund

• Performance based bonus

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support

• Diverse learning and development opportunities to further develop your skills

• Employee discounts on various products and services

What you can expect from our recruitment process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful recruitment process and are happy to provide appropriate support measures if necessary. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture. Modern facilities and processes ensure a safe working environment for everyone.

The recruitment process usually includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final interview and offer. We continuously review applications and close the call as soon as we have identified a strong selection of relevant candidates. Therefore, we recommend an early application. All information shall be treated as confidential.

Beware of fraud attempts: Nestlé contacts candidates exclusively through the company’s official email addresses and will never request payments or sensitive personal information during the recruitment process.

Ready to be a force for good?

Apply now and accelerate changes that improve the lives of people and our planet.

Être une force pour le bien et accélérer le changement qui améliore les vies et la planète

En tant qu'ingénieur en construction et coordination de projets chez Nestlé Suisse, votre mission est d'assurer la planification, la coordination et la réalisation de projets de construction de complexité variable pour notre usine THOMY à Bâle. Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Digital Food Safety Early Warning Associate Specialist at Nestlé Research, your mission is to enable the proactive detection of potential food safety issues by strengthening the evaluation of external scientific signals and the evolution of digital early warning systems.. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with food safety, quality, research, technology, and external data partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Digital Food Safety Early Warning Associate Specialist

• Strengthening proactive food safety early warning by scouting and evaluating emerging issues across priority contaminant areas.

• Identifying and assessing internal and external data sources that improve the detection, prioritization, and scientific evaluation of early signals.

• Contribute to the evaluation and deployment of digital technologies that enhance data-driven detection of emerging food safety topics.

• Testing prototypes that help transform early warning processes into scalable digital solutions.

• Participate in scientific collaborations that connect research, technology, and business needs to protect consumers.

• Delivering project activities with focus, rigor, and follow-through to support impactful food safety decisions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing basic chemistry knowledge and a good understanding of chemical contaminants, including how they can emerge, evolve, and impact food safety.

• Applying knowledge of food safety and quality processes in the context of supply chains, incident occurrence, issue evolution, and potential consumer impact.

• Using data and digital technologies in a food safety context, ideally to support data-driven risk assessment, root-cause analysis, and early warning decision-making.

• Collaborating effectively with diverse internal and external partners, while translating research into practical business impact.

• Communicating fluently in English; working proficiency in French is a plus.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Come specialista associato di sicurezza alimentare digitale presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di consentire il rilevamento proattivo di potenziali problemi di sicurezza alimentare rafforzando la valutazione dei segnali scientifici esterni e l'evoluzione dei sistemi di allarme rapido digitale. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con la sicurezza alimentare, la qualità, la ricerca, la tecnologia e i partner di dati esterni. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come specialista associato di sicurezza alimentare digitale

• Rafforzare la sicurezza alimentare proattiva in anticipo verificando e valutando i problemi emergenti in aree contaminanti prioritarie.

• Identificare e valutare fonti di dati interne ed esterne che migliorano il rilevamento, la priorità e la valutazione scientifica dei segnali iniziali.

• Contribuisci alla valutazione e alla distribuzione delle tecnologie digitali che migliorano il rilevamento dei dati degli argomenti di sicurezza alimentare emergenti.

• Testare i prototipi che aiutano a trasformare i processi di allarme precoce in soluzioni digitali scalabili.

• Partecipare a collaborazioni scientifiche che collegano la ricerca, la tecnologia e le esigenze aziendali per proteggere i consumatori.

• Fornire attività di progetto con focus, rigore e follow-through per supportare decisioni di sicurezza alimentare colpite.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare conoscenze di chimica di base e una buona comprensione dei contaminanti chimici, tra cui come possono emergere, evolvere e impatto sulla sicurezza alimentare.

• Applicare la conoscenza dei processi di sicurezza e qualità degli alimenti nel contesto delle catene di approvvigionamento, del verificarsi di incidenti, dell'evoluzione dei problemi e del potenziale impatto dei consumatori.

• Utilizzo dei dati e delle tecnologie digitali in un contesto di sicurezza alimentare, ideale per supportare la valutazione dei rischi, l'analisi delle cause della radice e il processo decisionale di avviso precoce.

• Collaborare efficacemente con diversi partner interni ed esterni, traducendo la ricerca nell'impatto pratico del business.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese; la competenza lavorativa in francese è un plus.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto.
