Standort: Vevey, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid / Vollzeit 100%
Vertragsart/Dauer: Unbefristeter Vertrag
Zielstartdatum: So bald wie möglich

Bewerbungsfrist: 6. September 2026

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und beschleunige Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern

Als IP Paralegal bei Nestlé ist es Ihre Mission, Senior Legal Counsels, die für Markenportfolios verantwortlich sind, zu unterstützen und Projekte zum geistigen Eigentum unabhängig voranzutreiben. Um einen unserer neu integrierten strategischen Geschäftsbereiche zu unterstützen, spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Sicherstellung eines starken Portfoliomanagements, einer effizienten Arbeitsweise und einer engen Zusammenarbeit mit internen Geschäfts- und Rechtsakteuren. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie die Marken von Nestlé durch genaue Markenrecherchen, Portfoliomanagement und rechtliche Recherchen schützen und stärken.

Wie Sie als IP Paralegal etwas bewirken können

• Durchführung von Markenverfügbarkeitssuchen, Analyse der Ergebnisse und klare Empfehlungen an die zuständigen Berater.

• Verwalten von Marken- und Industriedesign-Registrierungsprozessen von der Einreichung bis zur Erteilung für bestimmte Geschäftsbereiche, abgestimmt auf die Einführungspläne für Unternehmen.

• Umgang mit Einwänden von IP-Behörden, defensiven Einsprüchen und damit verbundenen Vereinbarungen, Verpflichtungen und Koexistenzbedingungen.

• Überwachung von wettbewerbsfähigen Markenveröffentlichungen, Unterstützung von Einsprüchen bei Bedarf und Erstellung von Berichten zu mäßig komplexen Rechtsfragen.

• Richtigkeit interner Aufzeichnungen durch Erstellen und Aktualisieren von Dateien, Andocken von Fristen und Überwachung wichtiger Meilensteine des Portfolios.

• Unterstützung der juristischen Forschung, der Sammlung von Beweismitteln und der Rechtsstreitigkeiten durch Organisation von Informationen, Verkaufszahlen und Marketingmaterialien für Marken- und Designangelegenheiten.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Mitbringen von solider Erfahrung in Marken innerhalb eines internationalen Umfelds oder einer Anwaltskanzlei.

• Sicheres Arbeiten mit Online-Datenbanken und webbasierten IP-Managementsystemen, idealerweise Memotech, oder eine starke digitale Agilität für schnelles Onboard.

• Kombinieren Sie exzellente Planungs- und Organisationsfähigkeiten mit hoher Genauigkeit und Liebe zum Detail.

• Flexibel, proaktiv und kooperativ sein, mit der Neugier und Agilität, autonom zu arbeiten und Initiative zu ergreifen.

• Neugierig auf Innovation und komfortables Arbeiten mit digitalen Tools, Datenanalysen und neuen Technologien, einschließlich KI-fähiger Lösungen, um die operative Exzellenz voranzutreiben und die zukünftige Entwicklung unserer IP-Dienste zu unterstützen.

• Fließend in geschriebenem und gesprochenem Englisch kommunizieren; gutes gesprochenes Französisch ist wünschenswert.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen.

Bei Société des Produits Nestlé S.A. stellen wir den Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type: Permanent

Travel Rate: 100% (Around 90% factory-based and 10% HQ-based)

Programme: 4-year development programme with 5–6-month international factory assignments across Nestlé’s global Operations network

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Performance Acceleration Senior Analyst at Nestlé Operations, you will join a unique 4-year development programme, completing international assignments of 5-6 months in Nestlé factories around the world. Your mission will be to accelerate operational performance and drive sustainable improvements across our global manufacturing network. You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with local factory teams, R&D experts, and corporate stakeholders.

With extensive international travel and hands-on exposure to complex manufacturing operations, this is your opportunity to grow your career, work across diverse cultures and production environments, and build a strong network within Nestlé's global Operations community.

How you’ll make an impact as a Performance Acceleration Senior Analyst

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance, productivity, and competitiveness across factories worldwide.

• Leading operational optimization and digital transformation projects that deliver measurable and sustainable results.

• Collaborating with factory leadership teams, technical experts, and global stakeholders to accelerate implementation and value creation.

• Coaching teams and supporting capability building to embed best practices and sustain long-term improvements.

• Managing cross-functional projects while leveraging Nestlé's global network to share knowledge, benchmark performance, and accelerate innovation.

• Strengthening operational excellence capabilities by promoting manufacturing standards and continuous learning across markets.

What will make you successful

• Bringing experience in a factory environment, such as production, quality, engineering, or related manufacturing functions. Previous line management experience is a plus.

• Applying strong project leadership and problem-solving skills to deliver meaningful business improvements.

• Using coaching and influencing capabilities to engage, develop, and support diverse teams.

• Embracing a highly international role that combines extensive travel, long-term factory assignments, and collaboration with diverse teams across different cultures and markets.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional language skills are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

Programma: Programma di sviluppo di 4 anni con incarichi di fabbrica internazionali da 5 a 6 mesi in tutta la rete operativa globale di Nestlé

Essere una forza per il cambiamento buono e accelera che migliora la vita e il pianeta

Come a Performance Acceleration Senior Analyst presso Nestlé Operations, ti unirai a un unico programma di sviluppo di 4 anni, completando incarichi internazionali di 5-6 mesi nelle fabbriche Nestlé in tutto il mondo. La vostra missione sarà quella di accelerare le prestazioni operative e promuovere miglioramenti sostenibili nella nostra rete di produzione globale. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con i team di fabbrica locali, gli esperti R&D e le parti interessate aziendali.

Con un ampio viaggio internazionale e un'esposizione pratica alle complesse operazioni di produzione, questa è la tua opportunità di crescere la tua carriera, lavorare in diverse culture e ambienti produttivi, e costruire una forte rete all'interno della comunità delle Operazioni globali di Nestlé.

Come farete un impatto come analista senior di accelerazione delle prestazioni

• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo che migliorano le prestazioni, la produttività e la competitività nelle fabbriche in tutto il mondo.

• I principali progetti di ottimizzazione operativa e trasformazione digitale che offrono risultati misurabili e sostenibili.

• Collaborare con team di leadership di fabbrica, esperti tecnici e stakeholder globali per accelerare l'implementazione e la creazione di valore.

• Squadre di coaching e capacità di supporto per incorporare le migliori pratiche e sostenere i miglioramenti a lungo termine.

• Gestione di progetti interfunzionali, sfruttando la rete globale di Nestlé per condividere conoscenze, prestazioni di benchmark e accelerare l'innovazione.

• Rafforzare le capacità di eccellenza operativa promuovendo gli standard di produzione e l'apprendimento continuo sui mercati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare esperienza in un ambiente di fabbrica, come la produzione, la qualità, l'ingegneria o le funzioni di produzione correlate. Precedente esperienza di gestione della linea è un vantaggio.

• Applicare una forte leadership di progetto e capacità di problem solving per fornire miglioramenti significativi di business.

• Usando le capacità di coaching e di influenza per coinvolgere, sviluppare e supportare diverse squadre.

• Abbracciando un ruolo altamente internazionale che combina viaggi estensivi, incarichi di fabbrica a lungo termine, e la collaborazione con diverse squadre in diverse culture e mercati.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese; competenze linguistiche aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

A Nestlé, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, una valutazione, un'intervista con il team di assunzione e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a essere una forza per il bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento che migliora le vite e il pianeta.

jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Senior Technician in Micronutrients and Phytochemicals Analytics at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide high-quality analytical support that helps research and operations teams make confident, science-based decisions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, analytical experts, technical teams and partners across Nestlé Research. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Technician in Micronutrients and Phytochemicals Analytics

• Delivering reliable analytical data that supports research, product quality and operational decisions.

• Developing and applying sample preparation methods within projects, including approaches for allergens, microparticles, micronutrients and phytochemicals analysis as well as spectroscopic measurements.

• Operating and maintaining advanced analytical equipment to ensure robust, timely and high-quality results.

• Evaluating analytical outcomes critically and turning results into clear insights for project teams and stakeholders.

• Contributing to method development and providing technical assistance to markets, including analytical support for allergen-related topics where the role may require handling or being in direct contact with allergenic food materials.

• Supporting project teams with technical assistance, sample preparation for trace analysis and analytical interpretation to ensure robust delivery of project objectives.

• Sharing expertise with colleagues, apprentices and students to build capability across analytical activities.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a Bachelor’s degree, CFC or equivalent qualification in analytical chemistry or a related field, with solid experience in sample preparation gained in industry or academia.

• Applying hands-on knowledge of allergen analysis and being comfortable working in a laboratory environment where allergenic food materials may be handled, prepared or analyzed, with potential direct contact as part of the role. You will also bring knowledge of spectroscopic measurements such as infrared, Raman or X-ray fluorescence, ideally including microparticle analysis. Knowledge in trace analysis and liquid chromatography is a plus.

• Using good laboratory practices, quality and safety standards to deliver accurate, compliant and trusted results.

• Collaborating with curiosity, analytical rigor and a solution-oriented mindset in diverse technical teams.

• Communicating confidently in English and French.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Senior Technician in Micronutrients e Phytochemicals Analytics presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di fornire un supporto analitico di alta qualità che aiuta i team di ricerca e di operazioni a prendere decisioni sicure e basate sulla scienza. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con scienziati, esperti analitici, team tecnici e partner in Nestlé Research. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come Senior Technician in Micronutrienti e Phytochemicals Analytics

• Fornire dati analitici affidabili che supportano la ricerca, la qualità del prodotto e le decisioni operative.

• Sviluppare e applicare metodi di preparazione dei campioni all'interno dei progetti, compresi gli approcci per allergeni, microparticelle, micronutrienti e analisi dei fitochimici e le misurazioni spettroscopiche.

• Funzionamento e mantenimento di attrezzature analitiche avanzate per garantire risultati robusti, tempestivi e di alta qualità.

• Valutare i risultati analitici in modo critico e trasformare i risultati in chiare intuizioni per i team di progetto e gli stakeholder.

• Contribuire allo sviluppo dei metodi e fornire assistenza tecnica ai mercati, compreso il supporto analitico per gli argomenti legati all'allergene in cui il ruolo può richiedere la manipolazione o essere in contatto diretto con materiali alimentari allergeni.

• Sostenere i team di progetto con assistenza tecnica, preparazione del campione per l'analisi delle tracce e l'interpretazione analitica per garantire una fornitura robusta degli obiettivi del progetto.

• Condivisione delle competenze con colleghi, apprendisti e studenti per costruire capacità nelle attività analitiche.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una laurea, CFC o qualifica equivalente in chimica analitica o un campo correlato, con solida esperienza nella preparazione del campione acquisita nell'industria o nell'accademia.

• Applicare la conoscenza pratica dell'analisi degli allergeni e lavorare comodo in un ambiente di laboratorio in cui i materiali alimentari allergeni possono essere trattati, preparati o analizzati, con potenziale contatto diretto come parte del ruolo. Potrai anche portare la conoscenza di misure spettroscopiche come la fluorescenza a raggi infrarossi, Raman o raggi X, idealmente compreso l'analisi microparticella. La conoscenza nell'analisi delle tracce e la cromatografia liquida è un plus.

• Utilizzando buone pratiche di laboratorio, standard di qualità e sicurezza per fornire risultati accurati, conformi e affidabili.

• Collaborare con curiosità, rigore analitico e una mentalità orientata alla soluzione in diversi team tecnici.

• Comunicare con fiducia in inglese e francese.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva, orientata al benessere, per creare valore condiviso.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. A seconda del ruolo, può essere inclusa una valutazione video. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Standort: Lausanne, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort / Vollzeit
Vertragsart/Dauer: Permanent

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als leitender Techniker für Mikronährstoffe und Phytochemie-Analytik bei Nestlé Research ist es Ihre Mission, qualitativ hochwertige analytische Unterstützung zu bieten, die Forschungs- und Betriebsteams hilft, selbstbewusste, wissenschaftlich fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Wissenschaftlern, Analyseexperten, technischen Teams und Partnern von Nestlé Research zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Senior-Techniker in Mikronährstoffen und Phytochemikalien Analytics etwas bewirken können

• Bereitstellung zuverlässiger Analysedaten, die Forschung, Produktqualität und operative Entscheidungen unterstützen.

• Entwicklung und Anwendung von Probenvorbereitungsmethoden im Rahmen von Projekten, einschließlich Ansätzen für Allergene, Mikropartikel, Mikronährstoffe und Phytochemikalienanalysen sowie spektroskopische Messungen.

• Betrieb und Wartung fortschrittlicher Analysegeräte, um robuste, zeitnahe und qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.

• Die Analyseergebnisse kritisch bewerten und die Ergebnisse in klare Erkenntnisse für Projektteams und Interessengruppen umwandeln.

• Beitrag zur Methodenentwicklung und technische Unterstützung der Märkte, einschließlich analytischer Unterstützung bei allergenbezogenen Themen, bei denen die Rolle möglicherweise den Umgang mit allergenen Lebensmitteln erfordert oder in direktem Kontakt mit diesen steht.

• Unterstützung der Projektteams durch technische Unterstützung, Probenvorbereitung für die Spurenanalyse und analytische Interpretation, um eine robuste Umsetzung der Projektziele zu gewährleisten.

• Austausch von Fachwissen mit Kollegen, Auszubildenden und Studenten, um Fähigkeiten über analytische Aktivitäten hinweg aufzubauen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie einen Bachelor-Abschluss, CFC oder gleichwertige Qualifikation in der analytischen Chemie oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit solider Erfahrung in der Probenvorbereitung in der Industrie oder der Wissenschaft gewonnen.

• Anwendung von praktischen Kenntnissen der Allergenanalyse und komfortables Arbeiten in einer Laborumgebung, in der allergene Lebensmittelmaterialien behandelt, zubereitet oder analysiert werden können, mit potenziellem direktem Kontakt als Teil der Rolle. Sie werden auch Kenntnisse über spektroskopische Messungen wie Infrarot-, Raman- oder Röntgenfluoreszenz mitbringen, idealerweise einschließlich Mikropartikelanalyse. Kenntnisse in der Spurenanalyse und Flüssigkeitschromatographie sind ein Plus.

• Verwendung guter Laborpraktiken, Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards, um genaue, konforme und vertrauenswürdige Ergebnisse zu liefern.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Neugier, analytischer Strenge und einer lösungsorientierten Denkweise in verschiedenen technischen Teams.

• Selbstsicher in Englisch und Französisch kommunizieren.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise, um gemeinsame Werte zu schaffen.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Abhängig von der Rolle kann eine Videobewertung enthalten sein. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Project Manager for Out-of-Home Beverage Systems at Nestlé Professional Product Technology Center for Coffee & Beverages, your mission is to lead the development, evaluation and deployment of connected beverage dispensing solutions that deliver reliable experiences for customers and consumers. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with research and development teams, markets, commercial partners and equipment manufacturers. This is an opportunity to expand your R&D project leadership experience, strengthen your technical expertise in connected beverage systems and build a global network across markets, functions and equipment partners.

How you’ll make an impact as a Project Manager – Out-of-Home Beverage Systems

• Leading multidisciplinary beverage-system projects from concept to deployment, aligning technology, timing, resources and quality.

• Evaluating and validating professional coffee machines and beverage dispensers to support technology selection, development and sourcing decisions.

• Coordinating field trials and in-cup testing to turn evidence into clear recommendations for stakeholders.

• Delivering accurate technical guidance and engaging learning materials that enable successful product launches and adoption.

• Strengthening equipment performance and user experience by resolving complex issues with manufacturers and deployment teams.

• Driving innovation, cost optimization and continuous improvement across development, evaluation and service processes.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong project leadership across hardware, software, connected technologies, planning, resources, budgets and quality.

jobs.title: Head of GBS Finance
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Act. Rate: Full-Time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Start date: February 2027

Deadline for applications: 25 September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As the Head of Global Business Services Finance at Nestlé, your mission is to act as a key finance partner to the Head of GBS and the GBS Management Team. You will shape the financial roadmap, challenge business decisions, and ensure disciplined planning, performance management, cost transparency and value realization across the global GBS network. Working closely with Center Heads, End-to-End solution leads, Global Process Owners, Markets, IT & Digital, and external partners, you will provide forward-looking insights, enable fact-based decisions, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes. You will lead an international finance team in different locations and help GBS deliver sustainable efficiency, effectiveness, and business value.

How you’ll make an impact as a Head of GBS Finance

• Bring deep expertise in the operational financial management of Global Business Services, using cost, efficiency, quality and service-performance insights to improve both efficiency and effectiveness.

• While leveraging AI tools, develop and maintain unit-cost, productivity and service-performance measures that connect financial outcomes with operational volumes, quality and service levels. Use internal and external benchmarks to identify improvement opportunities.

• Planning, coordinating and maintaining cost control of our Business Centers operations, measuring performance against plan and proposing necessary action plans to achieve targets in a context of important transition plan.

• Ensure challenging stretched targets are set for each Shared Service Center, end-to-end solution lead and Management Services unit, and tracking performance in a timely manner.

• Establish and govern a consistent framework to validate, track and report productivity, transformation benefits and value delivery, including agreed baselines, ownership, timing and reconciliation to reported financial results.

• Ensure a robust, documented and transparent billing and reconciliation process across the GBS network, including accurate and timely charges to internal customers, clear allocation drivers, dispute resolution and compliance with applicable transfer-pricing and accounting requirements.

• Own and continuously improve a transparent, driver-based costing and charging model for GBS services. Define financial evaluation and performance-tracking methodologies, assess business cases and contract changes, and ensure continuity plans reflect current financial exposures and operational requirements.

• Lead financial and commercial governance of external service providers, including contract economics, rate cards, indexation, volume commitments, service credits, change requests, invoice validation and value-for-money assessments.

• Lead, develop and inspire your team in an international environment while working collaboratively and cross functionally with IT & Digital, Global Process Owners and Markets.

What will make you successful

• Demonstrating senior finance leadership experience in GBS operational financial models and in complex global organizations, supported by relevant finance, accounting or business qualification.

• Applying financial analysis and co-piloting experience to various senior stakeholders through a strong command of management accounting, planning and forecasting, service costing, investment appraisal, financial controls and commercial contract management.

• Developing and improving financial systems and major business processes, with exposure to audit, project financial evaluation and contract reviews.

• Strong focus on compliance, rock solid reporting and internal controls.

• Managing and developing people, including virtual teams, with good organizational and planning skills.

• Communicating fluently in English, with superior written and verbal communication skills to effectively address and influence all levels, leadership team and internal customers.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Performance based bonus

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition, and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

#nestlecareerswitzerland

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Vevey, Svizzera
Atto. Tasso: Tempo pieno, 100%
Tipo di contratto / durata: Contratto permanente

Data di inizio: febbraio 2027

Termine ultimo per le domande: 25 settembre 2026

Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre

In qualità di capo delle finanze dei servizi commerciali globali a Nestlé, la vostra missione è di agire come partner finanziario chiave per il capo del GBS e del GBS Management Team. Formare la roadmap finanziaria, sfidare le decisioni aziendali e garantire la pianificazione disciplinata, la gestione delle prestazioni, la trasparenza dei costi e la realizzazione del valore in tutta la rete GBS globale. Lavorando a stretto contatto con Center Heads, la soluzione End-to-End conduce, Global Process Owners, Markets, IT & Digital e partner esterni, fornirete intuizioni previsionali, consentire decisioni basate sul fatto, e rafforzare la responsabilità per i risultati finanziari. Potrai guidare un team di finanza internazionale in diverse posizioni e aiutare GBS a fornire efficienza sostenibile, efficacia e valore aziendale.

Come farete un impatto come capo delle finanze GBS

• Portate una profonda esperienza nella gestione finanziaria operativa dei Servizi Globali di Business, utilizzando informazioni sui costi, sull'efficienza, sulla qualità e sulle prestazioni dei servizi per migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia.

• Sfruttando gli strumenti AI, sviluppare e mantenere misure a costi unitari, produttività e prestazioni di servizio che collegano i risultati finanziari con volumi operativi, qualità e livelli di servizio. Utilizzare benchmark interni ed esterni per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento.

• Pianificare, coordinare e mantenere il controllo dei costi delle operazioni dei nostri Centri Commerciali, misurare le prestazioni contro il piano e proporre piani di azione necessari per raggiungere gli obiettivi in un contesto di importante piano di transizione.

• Assicurarsi che obiettivi impegnativi allungati sono impostati per ogni Centro Servizi Condiviso, end-to-end soluzione lead e Gestione Servizi unità, e le prestazioni di monitoraggio in modo tempestivo.

• Stabilire e governare un quadro coerente per convalidare, tracciare e segnalare la produttività, i benefici di trasformazione e la consegna del valore, compresi i principi di base concordati, la proprietà, la tempistica e la riconciliazione per i risultati finanziari segnalati.

• Assicurare un processo di fatturazione e riconciliazione robusto, documentato e trasparente in tutta la rete GBS, inclusi oneri precisi e tempestivi ai clienti interni, driver di allocazione chiari, risoluzione delle controversie e conformità ai requisiti di trasferimento e contabilità applicabili.

• Migliorare costantemente un modello di costo e di ricarica basato sul driver trasparente per i servizi GBS. Definire metodologie di valutazione finanziaria e di tracciamento delle prestazioni, valutare i casi aziendali e i cambiamenti contrattuali, e garantire che i piani di continuità riflettano le attuali esposizioni finanziarie e i requisiti operativi.

• Condurre la governance finanziaria e commerciale dei fornitori di servizi esterni, tra cui l'economia di contratto, le carte di tasso, l'indicizzazione, gli impegni di volume, i crediti di servizio, le richieste di cambiamento, la validazione delle fatture e le valutazioni di valore per denaro.

• Guidare, sviluppare e ispirare il tuo team in un ambiente internazionale mentre lavori in collaborazione e intercedi in modo funzionale con IT & Digital, Global Process Owners and Markets.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Dimostrando l'esperienza di leadership finanziaria senior nei modelli finanziari operativi GBS e nelle organizzazioni globali complesse, supportate da finanza, contabilità o qualificazione aziendale.

• Applicando l'analisi finanziaria e l'esperienza co-pilota a vari stakeholder senior attraverso un forte comando di gestione contabile, pianificazione e previsione, costi di servizio, valutazione degli investimenti, controlli finanziari e gestione dei contratti commerciali.

• Sviluppo e miglioramento dei sistemi finanziari e dei principali processi aziendali, con esposizione a audit, valutazione finanziaria del progetto e recensioni dei contratti.

• Forte attenzione alla conformità, alla solid reporting rock e ai controlli interni.

• Gestire e sviluppare persone, tra cui team virtuali, con buone capacità organizzative e di pianificazione.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese, con superiori capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali per affrontare e influenzare efficacemente tutti i livelli, team di leadership e clienti interni.

• Dimostrando coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso.

A Nestlé, ci preoccupiamo della nostra gente

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Ci impegniamo a un processo di assunzione equo e trasparente e assicuriamo che tutte le applicazioni siano trattate con riservatezza.

La vostra applicazione in genere includerà una recensione iniziale, conversazioni con Talent Acquisition, e il team di assunzione, seguita da una discussione finale.

Pronto a crescere con noi?

Applicare ora e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre.

#nestlecareerswitzerland

Vertragsart/Dauer: Unbefristeter Vertrag

Startdatum: Februar 2027

Bewerbungsfrist: 25. September 2026

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und wachse durch Erfahrungen, die dich weiter bringen

Als Head of Global Business Services Finance bei Nestlé ist es Ihre Mission, als wichtiger Finanzpartner für den Head of GBS und das GBS Management Team zu fungieren. Sie gestalten die finanzielle Roadmap, fordern Geschäftsentscheidungen heraus und sorgen für disziplinierte Planung, Performance Management, Kostentransparenz und Wertrealisierung im globalen GBS-Netzwerk. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Center Heads, End-to-End-Lösungsleitern, Global Process Ownern, Markets, IT & Digital und externen Partnern erhalten Sie zukunftsweisende Einblicke, ermöglichen faktenbasierte Entscheidungen und stärken die Rechenschaftspflicht für finanzielle Ergebnisse. Sie leiten ein internationales Finanzteam an verschiedenen Standorten und helfen GBS, nachhaltige Effizienz, Effektivität und Geschäftswert zu liefern.

Wie Sie als Head of GBS Finance etwas bewirken

• Bringen Sie fundiertes Fachwissen im operativen Finanzmanagement von Global Business Services ein und nutzen Sie Kosten-, Effizienz-, Qualitäts- und Service-Performance-Insights, um sowohl Effizienz als auch Effektivität zu verbessern.

• Entwickeln und pflegen Sie bei der Nutzung von KI-Tools Einheitskosten-, Produktivitäts- und Serviceleistungsmaßnahmen, die die finanziellen Ergebnisse mit dem Betriebsvolumen, der Qualität und dem Serviceniveau verbinden. Verwenden Sie interne und externe Benchmarks, um Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.

• Planung, Koordination und Aufrechterhaltung der Kostenkontrolle unserer Geschäftszentren, Messung der Leistung im Vergleich zum Plan und Vorschlagen notwendiger Aktionspläne zur Erreichung der Ziele im Rahmen eines wichtigen Übergangsplans.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass anspruchsvolle Zielvorgaben für jedes Shared Service Center, die End-to-End-Lösungsleitung und die Management Services-Einheit festgelegt und die Leistung zeitnah verfolgt werden.

• Schaffung und Steuerung eines einheitlichen Rahmens zur Validierung, Nachverfolgung und Berichterstattung über Produktivität, Transformationsvorteile und Werterbringung, einschließlich vereinbarter Basislinien, Eigentümerschaft, Timing und Abgleich der gemeldeten Finanzergebnisse.

• Gewährleistung eines robusten, dokumentierten und transparenten Abrechnungs- und Abgleichprozesses im gesamten GBS-Netzwerk, einschließlich korrekter und zeitnaher Gebühren für interne Kunden, klarer Allokationstreiber, Streitbeilegung und Einhaltung der geltenden Verrechnungspreis- und Abrechnungsanforderungen.

• Eigene und kontinuierliche Verbesserung eines transparenten, fahrerbasierten Kosten- und Lademodells für GBS-Dienste. Definieren Sie die Methoden für die Finanzbewertung und die Leistungsverfolgung, bewerten Sie Geschäftsfälle und Vertragsänderungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Kontinuitätspläne die aktuellen finanziellen Risiken und operativen Anforderungen widerspiegeln.

• Führen Sie die finanzielle und kommerzielle Governance externer Dienstleister, einschließlich Vertragswirtschaft, Ratenkarten, Indexierung, Volumenzusagen, Servicegutschriften, Änderungswünsche, Rechnungsvalidierung und Bewertung des Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnisses.

• Führen, entwickeln und inspirieren Sie Ihr Team in einem internationalen Umfeld, während Sie mit IT & Digital, Global Process Ownern und Märkten zusammenarbeiten.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Demonstrieren Sie Führungserfahrung im Finanzbereich in operativen GBS-Finanzmodellen und in komplexen globalen Organisationen, unterstützt durch relevante Finanz-, Buchhaltungs- oder Geschäftsqualifikationen.

• Anwendung von Finanzanalyse und Co-Piloting-Erfahrung für verschiedene leitende Stakeholder durch eine starke Beherrschung der Management-Buchhaltung, Planung und Prognose, Service-Kostenrechnung, Investitionsbewertung, Finanzkontrollen und kaufmännisches Vertragsmanagement.

• Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Finanzsystemen und wichtigen Geschäftsprozessen unter Einbeziehung von Audits, der Bewertung von Projektfinanzen und Vertragsüberprüfungen.

• Starke Konzentration auf Compliance, solides Reporting und interne Kontrollen.

• Management und Entwicklung von Menschen, einschließlich virtueller Teams, mit guten organisatorischen und planerischen Fähigkeiten.

• Fließend in englischer sprache kommunizieren, mit überlegenen schriftlichen und mündlichen kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um alle ebenen, das führungsteam und interne kunden effektiv anzusprechen und zu beeinflussen.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen.

Bei Nestlé kümmern wir uns um unsere Mitarbeiter

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

Wir verpflichten uns zu einem fairen und transparenten Einstellungsprozess und stellen sicher, dass alle Bewerbungen vertraulich behandelt werden.

Ihre Bewerbung umfasst in der Regel eine erste Überprüfung, Gespräche mit Talent Acquisition und dem Einstellungsteam, gefolgt von einer abschließenden Diskussion.

Vous façonnerez la feuille de route financière, défierez les décisions d'affaires, et assurerez une planification disciplinée, la gestion du rendement, la transparence des coûts et la réalisation de la valeur dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial GBS. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les chefs de centre, les responsables de solutions de bout en bout, les propriétaires de processus mondiaux, les marchés, les technologies de l'information et du numérique et les partenaires externes, vous fournirez des informations prospectives, vous permettra de prendre des décisions fondées sur des faits et renforcerez la responsabilité pour les résultats financiers. Vous dirigerez une équipe financière internationale dans différents endroits et aiderez GBS à fournir une efficience, une efficacité et une valeur commerciale durables.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que chef de GBS Finance

• Apportez une expertise approfondie dans la gestion financière opérationnelle des services d'affaires mondiaux, en utilisant des données sur les coûts, l'efficience, la qualité et le rendement des services pour améliorer l'efficience et l'efficacité.

• Tout en tirant parti des outils d'IA, élaborer et maintenir des mesures du coût unitaire, de la productivité et du rendement du service qui relient les résultats financiers aux volumes opérationnels, à la qualité et aux niveaux de service. Utiliser des repères internes et externes pour identifier les possibilités d'amélioration.

• Planification, coordination et maintien du contrôle des coûts de nos activités de Business Centers, mesure du rendement par rapport au plan et proposition des plans d'action nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs dans un contexte d'important plan de transition.

• Veiller à ce que des objectifs ambitieux soient fixés pour chaque centre de services partagés, responsable de la solution de bout en bout et unité des services de gestion, et suivre les résultats en temps opportun.

• Établir et régir un cadre cohérent pour valider, suivre et rendre compte de la productivité, des avantages de la transformation et de la mise en valeur, y compris les niveaux de référence convenus, la propriété, le calendrier et le rapprochement des résultats financiers.

• Assurer un processus de facturation et de rapprochement solide, documenté et transparent dans l'ensemble du réseau GBS, y compris des frais exacts et opportuns pour les clients internes, des facteurs d'attribution clairs, le règlement des différends et la conformité aux exigences applicables en matière de prix de transfert et de comptabilité.

• Propre et continuellement améliorer un modèle transparent d'établissement des coûts et de tarification basé sur le conducteur pour les services GBS. Définir des méthodes d'évaluation financière et de suivi du rendement, évaluer les analyses de rentabilisation et les changements de contrat, et veiller à ce que les plans de continuité reflètent les expositions financières actuelles et les exigences opérationnelles.

• Diriger la gouvernance financière et commerciale des fournisseurs de services externes, y compris l'économie contractuelle, les cartes tarifaires, l'indexation, les engagements de volume, les crédits de service, les demandes de changement, la validation des factures et les évaluations de l'optimisation des ressources.

• Dirigez, développez et inspirez votre équipe dans un environnement international tout en travaillant en collaboration et en interfonctionnement avec IT & Digital, Global Process Owners and Markets.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Démontrer l'expérience des cadres supérieurs en matière de finance dans les modèles financiers opérationnels du GBS et dans les organisations mondiales complexes, appuyées par des qualifications pertinentes en matière de finance, de comptabilité ou d'entreprise.

• Appliquer l'analyse financière et l'expérience de copilote à divers intervenants supérieurs par une forte maîtrise de la comptabilité de gestion, de la planification et des prévisions, de l'établissement des coûts des services, de l'évaluation des placements, des contrôles financiers et de la gestion des contrats commerciaux.

• Développer et améliorer les systèmes financiers et les principaux processus opérationnels, avec une exposition à la vérification, à l'évaluation financière des projets et à l'examen des contrats.

• L'accent est mis sur la conformité, les rapports solides et les contrôles internes.

• Gérer et développer les personnes, y compris les équipes virtuelles, avec de bonnes compétences en organisation et en planification.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais, avec des compétences supérieures en communication écrite et verbale pour aborder et influencer efficacement tous les niveaux, l'équipe de leadership et les clients internes.

• Démontrer le courage, la collaboration, la rapidité et l'apprentissage continu, tout en traduisant les idées en un impact mesurable et en créant une valeur partagée.

Chez Nestlé, nous nous soucions de notre peuple

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte cotisation de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à mettre en place un processus d'embauche équitable et transparent et nous veillons à ce que toutes les demandes soient traitées de façon confidentielle.

Votre demande comprendra généralement un examen initial, des conversations avec Talent Acquisition et l'équipe d'embauche, suivies d'une discussion finale.

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Corporate Insurance Specialist – Non-Life & Insured Benefits at Nestlé, your mission is to support the effective renewal and administration of global insurance programs that protect our people, operations and assets. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Group Risk Services colleagues, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, markets, insurance brokers and insurers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Corporate Insurance Specialist – Non-Life & Insured Benefits

• Supporting timely, accurate renewals of global non-life and insured employee benefits programs.

• Coordinating insurance data, submissions and documentation to strengthen coverage decisions across markets.

• Ensuring policies, endorsements, premium allocations and payments are accurate and completed on time.

• Managing smaller insurance programs from renewal administration through payment and claims follow-up.

• Contributing to fair, effective selection processes for global and local insurers and brokers.

• Building trusted relationships that improve service quality and support consistent insurance delivery worldwide.

What will make you successful

• Bringing practical knowledge of insurance gained with an insurer, broker or corporate risk management team.

• Applying strong attention to detail across renewals, data collection, policy reviews, premium allocation and record keeping.

• Using sound knowledge of non-life insurance and insured employee benefits to support global programs confidently.

• Collaborating effectively across teams while building productive relationships with insurers, brokers and internal partners.

• Communicating fluently in English; French and German are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und beschleunige Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern

Als Corporate Insurance Specialist – Non-Life & Insured Benefits bei Nestlé ist es Ihre Mission, die effektive Erneuerung und Verwaltung globaler Versicherungsprogramme zu unterstützen, die unsere Mitarbeiter, Operationen und Vermögenswerte schützen. • Unterstützung zeitnaher, präziser Erneuerungen globaler Nichtlebens- und versicherter Mitarbeiterleistungsprogramme.

• Koordinierung von Versicherungsdaten, Einreichungen und Dokumentationen zur Stärkung von Deckungsentscheidungen in allen Märkten.

• Sicherzustellen, dass Richtlinien, Vermerke, Prämienzuweisungen und Zahlungen korrekt und rechtzeitig abgeschlossen sind.

• Verwalten kleinerer Versicherungsprogramme von der Erneuerungsverwaltung durch Zahlungs- und Schadensverfolgung.

• Beitrag zu fairen, effektiven Auswahlprozessen für globale und lokale Versicherer und Makler.

• Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen, die die Servicequalität verbessern und eine konsistente Versicherungslieferung weltweit unterstützen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie praktische Kenntnisse der Versicherung mit einem Versicherer, Broker oder Corporate Risk Management-Team gewonnen.

• Anwendung starker Aufmerksamkeit auf Details bei Erneuerungen, Datenerfassung, Richtlinienüberprüfungen, Premium-Zuweisung und Aufzeichnung.

• Mit fundiertem Wissen über Nichtlebensversicherungen und versicherte Arbeitnehmerleistungen können globale Programme selbstbewusst unterstützt werden.

• Teamübergreifend effektiv zusammenarbeiten und produktive Beziehungen zu Versicherern, Brokern und internen Partnern aufbauen.

• Fließend in Englisch kommunizieren; Französisch und Deutsch sind von Vorteil.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und beschleunigen Sie Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern.

You are responsible for end-to-end spend management, supplier selection, negotiations and managing relationships with coffee machine manufacturers to ensure a reliable, high-quality, and cost-effective supply chain aligned with Nestlé’s Procurement Standards. We operate on a truly global scale, bringing together over 40 nationalities across three dynamic hubs in Switzerland, Panama, and Malaysia. This is your chance to drive innovation, sustainability, and impact at scale, ensuring value creation through responsibly sourced supply across diverse categories.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Procurement Manager – Machines

• Define and implement the sourcing strategy for Nespresso Original Line and Milk frother, aligned with the Global Beverage Machine category while contributing to its development.

• Lead sourcing activities for supplier selection, leveraging negotiations, eRFX solutions, and by executing best‑in‑class Manufacturing and Supply Agreements.

• Build and lead the efficiency roadmap by driving cost‑reduction initiatives such as component standardization through platform approaches, best‑cost‑country sourcing and the use of alternative materials.

• Strengthen sourcing flexibility and supply risk mitigation across the full value chain, from Machine assembly to components and their raw materials.

• Build strong relationships with Nespresso Procurement business partners to unlock full category‑management value.

• Lead supplier development and compliance, including performance assessment and supplier profiling with clear targets and development plans.

What will make you successful

• Solid experience and proven proficiency in procurement within above‑market or large‑market structures, ideally in Contract Manufacturing procurement or technical categories.

• Dual competence supported by a degree in mechanical or electronic engineering (preferred).

• Advanced negotiation capabilities, with proven experience in eRFX and high‑value contract management.

• Strong analytical skills and Total Delivered Cost mindset, with the ability to manage multiple sub‑categories simultaneously (electronics, electro‑mechanical, plastic injection, CAPEX).

• Excellent communication abilities, enabling clear presentation of opportunities, results, and actionable recommendations.

• Fluent written and spoken English, any additional language considered as a strong plus.

Wie Sie als Global Procurement Manager etwas bewirken – Maschinen

jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Contract type / duration: Internship, 6 months
Start date: January/February 2026
Deadline for Application:

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As a Product Development Intern at Nestlé, your mission is to support the Powder Creamer Team in developing new solutions that optimize powder properties and manufacturing processes. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with Product Development Specialists, project team members and relevant NPTC stakeholders. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands-on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a Product Development Intern

• Support R&D product development projects and design experiments to identify powder creamer solutions with defined functional and sensory properties.

• Plan, prepare and conduct kitchen, benchtop, prototyping and pilot plant trials, including the preparation of prototypes for validation.

• Coordinate raw materials, product analytics, sample releases, sensory evaluations and keeping-quality tests.

• Assess the sustainability impact of developed solutions in collaboration with the project manager.

• Document, report and present project results while building effective collaboration with project team members and relevant NPTC stakeholders.

What will make you successful

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in progress or completed in Science and Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or a related field, with exposure to materials science, chemistry or physics.

• Strong interest in innovation and a problem-solving mindset, supported by hands-on curiosity and a willingness to learn.

• Good communication and networking skills, with experience collaborating in multidisciplinary teams and building relationships based on trust.

• Fluency in English. German is a strong asset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Konolfingen, Svizzera
Tipo di contratto / durata: Stage, 6 mesi
Data di inizio: gennaio/febbraio 2026
Termine ultimo per l'applicazione:

Essere una forza per il bene e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario

In qualità di Product Development Intern di Nestlé, la vostra missione è supportare il Powder Creamer Team nello sviluppo di nuove soluzioni che ottimizzano le proprietà della polvere e i processi produttivi. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con gli specialisti dello sviluppo di prodotto, i membri del team di progetto e le parti interessate NPTC rilevanti. Questa è la tua opportunità di fare un impatto mentre acquisisci esperienza pratica e mentorship per iniziare la tua carriera.

Come farete un impatto come un Interno per lo Sviluppo del Prodotto

• Sostenere i progetti di sviluppo del prodotto R&D e gli esperimenti di progettazione per identificare le soluzioni di crematrice a polvere con proprietà funzionali e sensoriali definite.

• Pianificare, preparare e condurre prove di cucina, panchina, prototipazione e impianti pilota, compresa la preparazione di prototipi per la validazione.

• Coordinare le materie prime, l'analisi dei prodotti, le versioni dei campioni, le valutazioni sensoriali e i test di qualità.

• Valuta l'impatto della sostenibilità delle soluzioni sviluppate in collaborazione con il project manager.

• Documento, report e risultati attuali del progetto, mentre la costruzione di una collaborazione efficace con i membri del team di progetto e le parti interessate NPTC rilevanti.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Corso di laurea o Master in corso o completato in Scienza e Tecnologia, Scienza alimentare, Ingegneria alimentare o un campo correlato, con esposizione a scienza dei materiali, chimica o fisica.

• Forte interesse per l'innovazione e una mentalità risolutrice di problemi, sostenuta dalla curiosità pratica e dalla volontà di imparare.

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e networking, con esperienza di collaborazione in team multidisciplinari e relazioni costruttive basate sulla fiducia.

• Fluency in inglese. Il tedesco è un bene forte.

• Dimostrando coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso.

A Nestlé, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a iniziare il tuo viaggio di carriera con noi?

Applicare ora e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario.

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Global Medical Communication Lead at Nestlé Nutrition and Health, your mission is to shape global, healthcare professional-centred communication for the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio, translating the latest science into compelling branded and non-branded engagements that support new and existing products. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, regulatory and scientific affairs, nutrition science, research and development, regional and market teams, external agencies, research partners and scientific experts. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Medical Communication Lead

• Developing global engagement and communication plans that strengthen healthcare professional understanding and increase recommendation, advocacy and adoption across the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio.

• Creating compelling scientific communication materials across in-person, digital and social channels to support new product launches and established product concepts.

• Shaping market awareness initiatives that build scientific credibility and support sustainable portfolio growth.

• Leading global programmes, congress activities, round tables and branded and non-branded advisory engagements that deepen trusted relationships with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating across global, regional and market teams to deliver communication toolkits that are relevant, consistent and ready for local adoption.

• Building productive partnerships with scientific experts and key opinion leaders (KOLs), agencies and research partners to turn insight and evidence into meaningful engagement.

• Élaborer des plans mondiaux d'engagement et de communication qui renforcent la compréhension des professionnels de la santé et accroissent les recommandations, la sensibilisation et l'adoption dans le portefeuille de vitamines, minéraux et suppléments premium.

• Élaborer des initiatives de sensibilisation au marché qui renforcent la crédibilité scientifique et soutiennent la croissance durable du portefeuille.

• Diriger les programmes mondiaux, les activités de congrès, les tables rondes et les engagements consultatifs de marque et non de marque qui approfondissent les relations de confiance avec les professionnels de la santé.

• Établir des partenariats productifs avec des experts scientifiques et des leaders d'opinion clés, des organismes et des partenaires de recherche pour transformer les connaissances et les données probantes en un engagement significatif.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une expérience importante en marketing médical dans la nutrition, les produits pharmaceutiques ou les environnements de santé des consommateurs.

• Appliquer la sensibilisation scientifique et réglementaire, y compris la connaissance des lignes directrices et des règlements externes pertinents pour les professionnels de la santé et les relations de plaidoyer pour développer des programmes et des matériels crédibles de professionnels de la santé de marque et non de marque.

• L'utilisation de la planification stratégique, de l'analyse des données et de la direction des projets pour faire passer les multiples priorités de la perspicacité à l'action, avec une expérience mondiale hautement privilégiée.

• Collaborer avec influence et intégrité entre les équipes mondiales tout en établissant des relations internes et externes de confiance.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais.

• Démontrer courage, collaboration, rapidité et apprentissage continu.

Chez Nestlé Nutrition et Santé, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an Associate Specialist Lipids at Nestlé Research, your mission is to strengthen scientific expertise and generate new insights in lipid physics and chemistry for food applications. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with multidisciplinary research teams, product development teams, expert networks, innovation partners, suppliers, universities, and research institutes. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist Lipids

• Building scientific knowledge of emerging methods, trends, and discoveries in lipid science and technology.

• Developing robust scientific concepts that translate lipid research into food applications and consumer benefits.

• Leading research projects and communicating scientific approaches and results to technical and business audiences.

• Designing and executing laboratory studies that advance understanding of lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Transferring scientific knowledge to development teams to accelerate innovation projects and successful product launches.

jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland

Company: Nestlé Research Konolfingen

Act. Rate: 80-100%

Type of contract: Permanent contract

Language: Fluent in English (B2 or better) and German (an advantage)

What we offer at Nestlé

Flexible work policies in terms of core hours. Please talk to us during the recruitment process about what flexibility could look like for you!

Genuine opportunities for career and personal development

Working in an international environment with the possibility to work worldwide after a successful experience in Konolfingen

Attractive additional benefits

Position summary

Our Nestlé Research and Development Center in Konolfingen (NRDK), Switzerland, develops for Nestlé worldwide, new products, processes and packaging concepts in the areas of Milk, plant-based and Nutrition products. This includes various process and filling technologies for liquid, powder or sterile products. In addition, it also provides technical assistance and engineering support for major Capital Investment Projects (CAPEX) to our factories.

As a member of our local Site-Engineering team you will support with your technical expertise and in close collaboration with your colleagues the daily pilot plant operations as well as the evaluation, design and implementation of local investment projects.

We offer a dynamic, inclusive, and international working environment with many opportunities across different companies, functions, and regions. Don’t miss the opportunity to join us and work with different teams in an agile and diverse context.

Daily activities of an Engineering Specialist

• Prepare high-level feasibility studies by asking the right questions to get a broad picture without going into too many details for new process and product ideas

• Prepare projects in further details to submit budget requests taking in account the various internal and external stakeholders of the NRDK

• Lead and execute the projects on site safely and in close collaboration with the various team members and specific operational functions leading to a successful commissioning, start-up and documented handover

• Assist our technicians/operators in troubleshooting and more complex root cause analysis on site

• Help to improve the asset intensity of our pilot plant and production facilities with detailed data analysis and specific process know-how

• Develop and drive sustainable solutions to meet our net zero goal by challenging and improving the status-quo

• Support the exploration and development of new technologies/products and help to qualify and industrialize them

What will make you successful

• Engineering degree (preferably process or mechanical engineering)

• Experience in process engineering and food industry including hygienic requirements are an advantage but not a must

• Excellent networking and communication skills

• End to end (E2E)-mindset (start projects with a clearly defined and well aligned scope ending up in successful handover including proper documentation)

• Passionate about making a difference in the professional environment

• Strong problem-solving skills as part of a bigger team and willing to apply them also in the field

• Full commitment to compliance (legal, safety, quality, finance) for all activities

• Willingness to develop specific expertise in defined areas to be the local subject matter expert

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive, and collaborative environment, that creates positive disruption, embraces innovation, and empowers people and teams to win.
We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.
Be a force for good. Join Nestlé and visit us on www.nestle.com.

Sintesi della posizione

Il nostro Centro di Ricerca e Sviluppo Nestlé a Konolfingen (NRDK), Svizzera, si sviluppa per Nestlé in tutto il mondo, nuovi prodotti, processi e concetti di imballaggio nei settori dei prodotti Latte, a base di piante e Nutrition. Questo include varie tecnologie di processo e di riempimento per prodotti liquidi, in polvere o sterili. Inoltre, fornisce assistenza tecnica e supporto ingegneristico per i principali progetti di investimento di capitale (CAPEX) alle nostre fabbriche.

In qualità di membro del nostro team di Site-Engineering locale, supporterai con la tua competenza tecnica e in stretta collaborazione con i tuoi colleghi le operazioni quotidiane degli impianti pilota, nonché la valutazione, la progettazione e l'implementazione di progetti di investimento locali.

Offriamo un ambiente di lavoro dinamico, inclusivo e internazionale con molte opportunità in diverse aziende, funzioni e regioni. Non perdere l’opportunità di unirsi a noi e lavorare con diverse squadre in un contesto agile e vario.

Attività quotidiane di uno specialista di ingegneria

• Preparare studi di fattibilità di alto livello facendo le domande giuste per ottenere un quadro ampio senza entrare in troppi dettagli per nuove idee di processo e di prodotto

• Preparare i progetti in ulteriori dettagli per presentare richieste di bilancio tenendo conto delle varie parti interessate interne ed esterne della NRDK

• Guidare ed eseguire i progetti in loco in modo sicuro e in stretta collaborazione con i vari membri del team e specifiche funzioni operative che portano ad una messa in servizio di successo, start-up e consegna documentata

• Assistere i nostri tecnici/operatori nella risoluzione dei problemi e nell'analisi delle cause radice più complessa sul sito

• Aiuta a migliorare l'intensità patrimoniale del nostro impianto pilota e delle strutture produttive con analisi dettagliate dei dati e know-how di processo specifico

• Sviluppare e guidare soluzioni sostenibili per soddisfare il nostro obiettivo netto zero sfidando e migliorando lo status-quo

• Sostenere l'esplorazione e lo sviluppo di nuove tecnologie / prodotti e contribuire a qualificarli e industrializzarli

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Laurea in ingegneria (preferibilmente processo o ingegneria meccanica)

• L'esperienza nell'ingegneria dei processi e nell'industria alimentare, compresi i requisiti igienici sono un vantaggio ma non un must

• Ottimi competenze di networking e comunicazione

• Fine to end (E2E)-mindset (progetti di avvio con un campo di applicazione chiaramente definito e ben allineato che finiscono per una consegna di successo, compresa la documentazione corretta)

• Appassionato a fare la differenza nell'ambiente professionale

• Forte capacità di problem solving come parte di un team più grande e disposto ad applicarli anche nel campo

• Completo impegno a rispettare (legale, sicurezza, qualità, finanza) per tutte le attività

• La volontà di sviluppare competenze specifiche in aree definite per essere l'esperto di materia locale

A Nestlé, vogliamo aiutare a plasmare un mondo migliore e più sano, ispirare le persone a vivere vite più sane e dare impatto a una scala e ritmo che fa la differenza. Lo facciamo promuovendo un ambiente diversificato, amichevole, solidale e collaborativo, che crea interruzioni positive, abbraccia l'innovazione, e consente alle persone e ai team di vincere.
Ci proponiamo di assumere persone amichevoli, rispettose e stimolanti che si preoccupano della vita della gente che tocchiamo ogni giorno.
Sii una forza per il bene. Unisciti a Nestlé e visitaci su www.nestle.com.

jobs.description:

Work model: Hybrid / Full time
